info.description: Partial executable contract. Other routes are individually tracked in route-inventory.json. Bootstrap setup and provider protocols are not covered by this document.

get.summary: Process liveness only; does not assert dependency readiness.
Already-initialized normal mode; not bootstrap setup status.

post.summary: Discard telemetry and return an empty 200 response.
post.description: The handler does not parse or retain the request body. No request-body schema or processing guarantee is claimed. The successful response has no body and no Content-Type.

get.description: No path/query parameters or request body are consumed. Authorization and x-api-key are ignored by this public route. JSON responses only: no empty-body response, SSE or WebSocket upgrade. Public DTO explicitly excludes secrets; configured public IDs and site keys are intentional. All top-level data fields are required and non-null except custom_endpoints. Rate limiting is conditional on public source IP and configured settings.

custom_menu_items.description: Admin-only entries filtered out. page_slug and hide_open_button are omitted when empty/false; visibility is not constrained beyond the actual string DTO.

custom_endpoints.description: Required field. Empty/invalid stored JSON becomes []; stored JSON null remains null in the current handler.

balance_low_notify_threshold.description: JSON number; fractional values are retained.

429.description: Configured panel rate limit exceeded. Retry-After is a positive number of seconds.

Retry-After.description: Positive whole seconds until retry; emitted by the real panel limiter.

500.description: Settings repository failure; generic error conceals the underlying cause.

get.summary: Current version for the administrator frontend.
get.description: No path/query parameters or request body are consumed; force is not a parameter of this endpoint. Requires admin JWT or x-api-key. An upgrade-shaped request (Upgrade: websocket and Connection containing upgrade) may carry jwt.<token> in Sec-WebSocket-Protocol; this middleware alternative has precedence over x-api-key, which has precedence over Authorization. Invalid higher-priority credentials never fall back. The handler still returns ordinary JSON 200, never 101/SSE/WebSocket frames. Active JWT user, token version, optional session binding and admin role are checked; API key maps to GetFirstAdmin. Compliance acknowledgement is required and configured panel limits may apply. Update lookup failures fall back to current version, not an invented handler error.

200.description: Current version; updater warnings and other release fields are not returned.

401.description: Missing/malformed credentials, invalid admin key or token, expired token, missing/inactive user, revoked token or session binding mismatch. Codes: UNAUTHORIZED, INVALID_ADMIN_KEY, INVALID_TOKEN, TOKEN_EXPIRED, USER_NOT_FOUND, USER_INACTIVE, TOKEN_REVOKED, SESSION_BINDING_MISMATCH.

requestBody.description: JSON decoded by production Gin/encoding/json binding: unknown fields ignored; null pointer fields mean unset. The offline contract checker rejects ambiguous duplicate members, malformed UTF-8 and trailing values, while production binding may accept these; this is a tooling integrity rule, not a claimed ingress rejection. Numeric limits finite/nonnegative. PUT resets are opt-in; null IP arrays unchanged, [] clears. Declared integer DTO fields additionally require plain JSON integer tokens: 11.0 and 11e0 do not bind to Go int/int64 even though JSON Schema treats them as integers. The request checker enforces this binding restriction separately from schema validation. Integer ranges target the published amd64/arm64 builds (64-bit Go int); custom 32-bit builds are outside this contract.

name.description: Required nonempty string; whitespace accepted; stored HTML escaped.

group_id.description: Nullable signed int64; plain integer JSON token only (no decimal point or exponent). Numeric range is a binding limit, not group existence or authorization.

custom_key.description: Absent/null/empty generates a key; otherwise at least 16 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen, uniqueness enforced; no creation max length enforced here.

ip_whitelist.description: IP addresses or CIDR patterns; invalid patterns return 400.

ip_blacklist.description: IP addresses or CIDR patterns; invalid patterns return 400.

expires_in_days.description: Nullable positive Go int on published amd64/arm64 builds (64-bit); plain integer JSON token only (no decimal point or exponent). The maximum is a binding limit, not a new business expiry cap or guarantee about extreme resulting dates.
